title: Queue lease expiry and stale acknowledgements
prompt: A worker queue leases jobs to consumers. Expired jobs must be redelivered, but an old worker's late acknowledgement currently removes the new worker's lease. Fix Queue in queue.py: claim(now, ttl) returns (job_id, token) or None, ack(job_id, token) succeeds only for the current lease, and attempts increase on each claim. Preserve pending order and no duplicate concurrent claims. Run tests and validate.
